business_problem: Hexis needed to translate dense exercise physiology and nutrition science into instant, personalized athlete guidance while synchronizing wearable data globally and shipping new product features much faster.
solution_summary: Hexis uses Google Cloud to address this challenge: Hexis needed to translate dense exercise physiology and nutrition science into instant, personalized athlete guidance while synchronizing wearable data globally and shipping new product features much faster. Compute Engine processes training, meal, and wellness data and runs the stateless application instances that power real-time coaching, serving as the compute layer. Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL stores the multi-regional athlete data that stays synchronized across Europe, the US, and Australia, serving as the storage layer. Gemini interprets natural-language, image, and voice inputs and converts them into structured nutrition data and coaching explanations, serving as the serving layer. Gemini Notebook centralizes scientific research into an internal knowledge base that accelerates onboarding and feature work, serving as the serving layer.
